theorem.statement: For the unit Euclidean 3-ball with S^2 boundary, the differential-form Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator on coexact 1-forms is a positive first-order self-adjoint shell operator with exact eigenvalue sigma_ell = ell + 1. Its one-loop trace-log generator is therefore w_ell = log(ell + 1), which lies in the same logarithmic shell class as (1/2) log lambda_ell.

derived: Integrating out linear bulk propagation naturally produces a boundary effective Hessian of Dirichlet-to-Neumann type.
On the model B^3/S^2 coexact 1-form problem, the exact shell eigenvalue is sigma_ell = ell + 1.
The associated one-loop generator is logarithmic: w_ell = log(ell + 1).
verified: At N=712, the DtN determinant plus branch gives n_s = 0.963858187553.
At N=712, the DtN determinant minus branch gives n_s = 0.963959517376.
At N=712, the equal branch average gives n_s = 0.963908849852.
At N=712, the exact shell target gives n_s = 0.963908639282.
conditional: The physical IO coexact-sector Hessian is the differential-form Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator (or a same-symbol first-order deformation) for the relevant boundary-to-bulk linear problem.
The covariance payload coefficient is K_gauge/x on that DtN determinant kernel.
